clips.send: A friend sends this to someone stuck dreaming small - proof that just looking at what you want rewires your brain, real awe.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's advice for expanding what feels possible: go look at things you can't afford yet.

Walk through a $20 million yacht. Tour an open house at a mansion. Try on a Rolex you're not buying. Look at private jets up close.

None of it costs you anything, and it isn't about pretending you already have it. It's about letting your mind see the thing is real and reachable by someone.

Kevin calls it dream building - he says it physically changes how your brain works, the more curious you get the more it stimulates.
